hooks.command: echo '🧭 Context was just compacted. Re-ground before continuing: (1) if the current work has a tracking issue or PR, re-read its body/checkpoint comment — that is the authoritative state, not the summary; (2) re-derive in-flight state from git status and gh (open PRs, recent comments) instead of trusting recalled detail; (3) if orchestrating, re-run the budget check before the next subagent fan-out.'

changed=$( { git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null; git diff --name-only --cached 2>/dev/null; git log --diff-filter=ACMR --name-only --pretty=format: --since="4 hours ago" 2>/dev/null; } | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$changed" -gt 3 ]; then echo "💡 Session touched $changed files — consider /harness retro to capture learnings"; fi
